name: Shoprite Holdings Ltd
summary: Shoprite Holdings Ltd, an investment holding company, engages in the food retail and wholesale business in South Africa and internationally. It operates through the Supermarkets RSA, Supermarkets Non-RSA, and Other Operating segments. The company offers food, clothing, general merchandise, cosmetics, and liquor products under the Checkers, Checkers Hyper, and Usave brands. It also offers a range of perishable and non-perishable food items through supermarket/convenience outlets primarily under the OK brand; and financial services and products, as well as operates retail liquor outlets under the OK Liquor brand; and liquor stores under the Shoprite LiquorShop and Checkers LiquorShop brands.
